name: multipush
description: MultiPush - 多平台智能发布系统

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.test:publish-ui: node scripts/smoke-douyin-publish.mjs && node scripts/smoke-wechat-publish.mjs && node scripts/smoke-wechatpic-publish.mjs && node scripts/smoke-zhihu-publish.mjs && node scripts/smoke-sspai-publish.mjs && node scripts/smoke-blog-publish.mjs && node scripts/smoke-xiaohongshu-publish.mjs && node scripts/smoke-weibo-publish.mjs && node scripts/smoke-toutiao-publish.mjs && node scripts/smoke-baijiahao-publish.mjs && node scripts/smoke-figure-captions.mjs && node scripts/smoke-douban-ui.mjs && node scripts/smoke-juejin-jianshu-ui.mjs && node scripts/smoke-draft-modes-ui.mjs && node scripts/smoke-bilibili-ui.mjs
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:build && npm --prefix desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run desktop:build && npm --prefix desktop run smoke
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run desktop:build && npm --prefix desktop run dist:win
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run desktop:build && npm --prefix desktop run dist:mac
scripts.smoke:draft-modes: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-draft-modes-ui.mjs && node scripts/smoke-bilibili-ui.mjs
